We need to answer based on policy excerpts. The question: "Our backend developer found that records past page one weren't showing up and asked me to check how the API's pagination is meant to work."

We have relevant excerpts DOC-026 parts 1-3 describing pagination: list endpoints return one page, with next_cursor field; need to follow cursor until absent; otherwise only first page. So answer: explain that you must check next_cursor and loop until none, etc.

We should provide short specific answer. Use post_reply.

function.arguments: {"message":"Meridian’s list endpoints return results one page at a time. Each response includes a `next_cursor` field when there are more pages; if `next_cursor` is missing, you’ve reached the last page. To retrieve all records you need to loop: call the endpoint, read the `next_cursor`, and immediately request the next page using that cursor. Continue this process until the response no longer contains a `next_cursor`. If you only read the first page, you’ll see the behavior your developer described—records beyond page one will be silently omitted."}
